PUBLIC-SAFETY HIRING

More context.
Fewer unanswered questions.

A background investigation connects the application to the person's history.

Break Point Investigations supports pre-employment background investigations for sworn personnel and professional staff. DJ's published agency proposal describes work involving prior agencies, references, employment history, and residential history.

The engagement begins with your agency's requirements, the candidate population, and the information needed for a considered hiring decision.

THE INVESTIGATIVE LENS

Follow the history.
Develop the context.

The scope is tailored to your agency and assignment.

01

Employment history

Explore prior work experience and relevant employer information within the agreed scope.

02

References & follow-up

Speak with references and develop additional leads to better understand the applicant's history.

03

Residential history

Examine relevant residential information as one part of a fuller background picture.

04

Prior agency coordination

Coordinate with prior agencies when applicable, including for lateral candidates.

EXPERIENCE WITH AGENCY NEEDS

Understand the standard.
Respect the responsibility.

DJ's agency proposal identifies 24 years of law-enforcement experience, including service as a Contra Costa Sheriff's Office lieutenant and Richmond police officer.

The proposal describes conducting background investigations in accordance with P.O.S.T. standards. Discuss the requirements that apply to your agency, current scope, and deliverables directly with DJ.
